title: Its a scam
body: This app is built to sell you the subscription. Once you are in it has a terrible interface and very limited flexibility to adjust it to your needs. It also takes you like 15 minutes of personal info to the hit a paywall.
author: Un Limeño Cualquiera

title: The settings for anchoring the habits have some glitches
body: I tried to anchor the meditation habit to de drink water one and whenever i went to check it had changed the trigger habit i had set. You guys should check that.
author: María Paula Pacheco
